## Summary
<!-- Please describe what problems your PR addresses. -->
The User Role Scope form fails to save changes when the "Save" button is clicked. No API request is triggered, and no feedback is provided to the user.
Root cause analysis revealed that the form is missing an onSubmit handler, preventing submission logic from executing.
This results in role scope configurations not being persisted, blocking user access control setup.
